name: building-research-progression-visual
description: Visual check of the research tier-gate and the full T1 -> T2 -> T3 progression: Tier 1 Research Center placed, a direct Tier 2 attempt rejected before research, Tier 2 researched instantly (cost-only), an early Tier 3 attempt rejected by the conditions gate, then Tier 2 built for real once researched, Tier 3 research queued and progressed over its 50-tick duration, and finally a Tier 3 Research Center built. Starting cash is a setup cheat sized to cover the whole chain ($25,000 + $5,000 + $60,000 + $12,000 + $120,000 = $222,000 plus upkeep), the same treatment its sibling building-research-visual.json uses — every purchase here is one the player could genuinely afford and click.

steps.description: Setup cheat: the whole T1->T2->T3 chain costs $222,000 in construction and research, so the default $50,000 start cannot reach the end of this file. $230,000 funds every purchase legitimately — the console refuses what a player could not afford, so an underfunded start would stop this scenario at the Tier 2 build.

role: guard (issue #515): selecting tier 2 in the catalog row's own tier dropdown is a real interaction; the Place button is then genuinely disabled — `refreshCatalogButtons`'s `locked` check (BuildMenu.ts: `btn.disabled = cash < def.constructionCost || locked`) is true since tier 2 is not researched yet. Cash is not the reason — $205,000 comfortably covers the $60,000 Tier 2 cost; only the research lock blocks it.

expect.note: rejected: tier 2 not yet researched (funds are ample)

steps.description: Tier-2 (first upgrade) is cost-only — no duration, no conditions.

Rejected (conditions_not_met) — tier-3's own condition (tier-2 research completed) is not yet satisfied: tier-2 is only queued, not yet processed by a tick. Demonstrates the conditions gate before the flow below completes tier-2 and queues tier-3 successfully.

expect.note: rejected: tier 2 research is only queued, not yet completed

steps.description: Tier-2 research is queued and still pending — nothing has ticked yet.
Tier-2 is 0-duration — a single tick is enough to complete it.

expect.note: tiny ambient drain from the tick itself, separate from the research (paid in full at queue time) — decreased not equals per Finding #12

steps.description: Tier-2 research has completed — the queue is empty again and the Tier 2 Research Center is unlocked.

A real player click now: Tier 2 is researched and the $60,000 cost is affordable, so the Place button is enabled and the tile picker completes the purchase. This is the step the old, underfunded version of this file could only pass by overdrawing through the console — with the funds guard in place and enough starting cash, the same build succeeds legitimately through the UI.

expect.note: tier 2 now buildable — real unlock. cash uses decreased not equals since this follows a tick step (Finding #12)

steps.description: Now succeeds — tier-3's condition (tier-2 research completed) is satisfied and the $12,000 cost is affordable. Unlike tier-2, tier-3 research has a real 50-tick duration, which the two tick steps below advance.

expect.note: queued for real — cash uses decreased not equals since building upkeep has been accruing since the tick step (Finding #12)

steps.description: Tier-3 research is in progress — queued this tick, 50 ticks still to run.
First slice of tier-3's 50-tick research duration.
Tier-3 research is still in progress — 10 of its 50 ticks are done.
Remaining 40 ticks — carries tier-3 research to its full 50-tick duration.
Tier-3 research has completed at the 50-tick mark — the queue is empty and the Tier 3 Research Center is unlocked.
A real player click: tier 3 is researched, so the Place button is enabled and the $120,000 build completes. The full T1->T2->T3 progression this file is named for now genuinely runs end to end.

expect.note: tier 3 built for real — the progression completes, matching this file's own name
